question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Obvious
solution:
The correct answer is **'hidden'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word **'obvious'** means easily seen or understood; clear(जो आसानी से दिखाई दे या समझ में आए; स्‍पष्‍ट).

 
 
• **Example: ***The answer to this question seems **obvious** to me.*
 
 
 
• The marked option 'Hidden' means **being out of sight or not readily apparent.**
 
• **From **the given meaning and example sentence, it is obvious that 'obvious' and 'hidden' are antonyms.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Here are the meanings and example sentences of the other options:
 
• **"Plain"** means clear or easily understood, so it is not an antonym of "obvious".
 
 
• Example: "The instructions were **plain **and easy to follow."
 
 
 
• **"Vapid"** means dull or lacking in interest, so it is not an antonym of "obvious".
 
 
• Example: "The movie was **vapid **and uninteresting."
 
 
 
• **"Active" **means engaged in action or movement, so it is not an antonym of "obvious".
 
 
• Example: "The athletes were very **active **during the game."
